def IsGoodFor (A : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : Prop := A 0 = n ∧ StrictMono A ∧
  ∀ j, IsLeast
    {m : ℕ | A j < m ∧ ∀ a b, Finset.Icc a b ⊆ Finset.Iic j → m ≠ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc a b, A i}
    (A <| j + 1)

Proof sketch: show `(∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 0 j, A i) + 1` is a member of the set, and then the lowerBounds half of the IsLeast, `(hA.2.2 j).2`, gives `A (j + 1) ≤` it. Membership has two halves. The first, `A j < (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 0 j, A i) + 1`, holds because `A j` is one of the summands (`Finset.mem_Icc`, `Finset.single_le_sum`). The second, that it is not any block sum with `Finset.Icc a b ⊆ Finset.Iic j`, holds because such a block is a subset of `Finset.Icc 0 j` (`Finset.Iic j = Finset.Icc 0 j` on ℕ) so its sum is at most `∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 0 j, A i` by `Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset`, strictly less than the claimed value.
